lines.beaver: 요즘 세대 차이가 크다는 말을 자주 들어요.
lines.beaver_en: I often hear that the generation gap is big these days.
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum sedae chaiga keudaneun mareul jaju deureoyo.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 제 고국에서도 세대 이야기가 많아요.
lines.en: That's right. People talk about generations a lot in my homeland too.
lines.roman: Majayo. Je gogugeseodo sedae iyagiga manayo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Do you often hear news from your homeland?
lines.learner: 네, 아침에 일어나기가 무섭게 뉴스를 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, I check the news as soon as I wake up.
lines.roman: Ne, achime ireonagiga museopge nyuseureul bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: How are the fellow countrymen who left home doing?
lines.en: The fellow countrymen here help each other a lot.

lines.beaver_en: I heard the generational conflict is big in your homeland.
lines.learner: 네, 구세대는 젊은 사람 생각을 잘 몰라요.
lines.en: Yes, the older generation doesn't really understand young people.
lines.roman: Ne, gusedaeneun jeolmeun saram saenggageul jal mollayo.

lines.learner: 젊은 세대는 남의 눈을 별로 신경 안 써요.
lines.en: The young generation doesn't care much about what others think.
lines.roman: Jeolmeun sedaeneun namui nuneul byeollo singyeong an sseoyo.

lines.beaver: 하긴, 우리 부모님은 남의 시선을 중시하세요.
lines.beaver_en: True, my parents care a lot about how others see them.
lines.beaver_roman: Hagin, uri bumonimeun namui siseoneul jungsihaseyo.
lines.learner: 우리 할머니도 그러세요. 어릴 때부터 그러셨대요.
lines.en: My grandmother too. She says she's been like that since childhood.
lines.roman: Uri halmeonido geureoseyo. Eoril ttaebuteo geureosyeotdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How are kids in your homeland doing these days?
lines.learner: 아이들이 학교가 끝나기가 무섭게 학원에 가요.
lines.en: Kids go to cram school as soon as school ends.
lines.roman: Aideuri hakgyoga kkeunnagiga museopge hagwone gayo.

lines.beaver_en: That's really busy. They must have no time to play.
lines.learner: 네, 그래도 다들 열심히 해서 인정받고 싶어 해요.
lines.en: Yes, but they all want to work hard and be recognized.
lines.roman: Ne, geuraedo dadeul yeolsimhi haeseo injeongbatgo sipeo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 그런데 한국에 온 지는 얼마나 됐어요?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, how long have you been in Korea?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde hanguge on jineun eolmana dwaesseoyo?
lines.learner: 저는 베트남에서 온 지 삼 년 됐어요. 회사원이에요.
lines.en: I came from Vietnam three years ago. I'm an office worker.
lines.roman: Jeoneun beteunameseo on ji sam nyeon dwaesseoyo. Hoesawonieyo.

lines.beaver: 다음에 고국 이야기 또 들려주세요. 반가웠어요.
lines.beaver_en: Tell me more about your homeland next time. Nice talking.
lines.beaver_roman: Daeume goguk iyagi tto deullyeojuseyo. Bangawosseoyo.
lines.learner: 네, 고국 소식 들리면 또 전해 드릴게요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll share more when I hear news from home.
lines.roman: Ne, goguk sosik deullimyeon tto jeonhae deurilgeyo.
